description: Le luwak (civette palmiste hors d'Indonésie) s'élève dans une étable de niveau 2. Il fonctionne comme le cochon, mais trouve des grains de café gesha au lieu de truffes, y compris des grains rares de grande qualité. On ne peut en garder que 4.
description_en: Luwak, also known as Asian palm civets outside Indonesia, are farm animals the player can raise in a level 2 barn. Luwak function similarly to pigs, except instead of truffles they are able to find gesha coffee beans for the player from around Coral Island, including rarer, high quality, coffee beans. Only 4 Luwak can be kept in the farm.

extra.outil: None;Must be outside with grass to eat
